pitches.subject: Hammered brass planters from Moradabad for Kayu Home
pitches.body:
Hello Kayu Home team,

I noticed you stock Nkuku brass planters, including the Atsu and the Antique Brass Tembesi Etched Planter, alongside your Asian-sourced antiques. We make hammered brass planters in a hammered gold finish in Moradabad, and I think they would sit well in that range.

Our goods enter the UK at zero import duty under the India-UK CETA, with proof of origin supplied. Our MOQ is 300 pieces, and our current quote range is £6.72–£12.10 FOB per piece.

We can label each piece clearly as a cachepot with no drainage, or offer a variant with drainage holes and a plug, so your customers know exactly what they are buying.

Would you like a few samples or our catalogue? I would be glad to send either.

Kind regards,

[Your name], [Company], Moradabad
